reforms.description: Canada established a new Department of Industry in 1963 to coordinate industrial policy and support manufacturing competitiveness. This institutional reform created a dedicated government body to oversee industrial development and innovation-related initiatives.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Creation of a dedicated institutional body to coordinate industrial policy and innovation support is expected to improve policy coherence and allocative efficiency in innovation spending, supporting productivity growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'Canada established a new Department of Industry in 1963' using past tense, indicating implementation.
reforms.importance_rationale: Establishment of a new government department represents a significant institutional change, though not a system-wide overhaul of R&D funding or governance.
reforms.source_quote: Other measures taken in 1963 consisted of the establishment of a new Department of Industry and the Economic Council of Canada.

reforms.description: Canada created the Economic Council of Canada in 1963 as an advisory body designed to assess medium- and long-term economic prospects and recommend policies to realize the economy's growth potential, including innovation and industrial policy.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Creation of an advisory council to assess economic prospects and recommend growth-oriented policies is expected to improve policy design and coordination for innovation and industrial development.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'Canada created the Economic Council of Canada in 1963' using past tense, indicating implementation.
reforms.importance_rationale: Establishment of a new advisory institution represents a significant institutional change in policy-making capacity, though not a direct R&D funding or governance overhaul.
reforms.source_quote: The Economic Council will assess the medium- and long-term prospects of the economy and recommend to the government policies which will best realise the growth potentialities of the economy.
